intent: Finish binding-reinstatement T5 (attempt 3: guard, lifecycle fix, assertions)
instructions:
# Context
The T5 implementation (engineer attempt 2) is ALREADY IN THE WORKING TREE across the 9 original paths. Do NOT rewrite it. Add only the deltas below, then verify. Read the approved spec ONCE: /home/opencode/projects/default/mcp-bridge/.omp/artifacts/binding-reinstatement/spec.md (sha256 12443b3fc04fd01db14752abf7c4cecd28620a985e9d09d83f8bb826a1832da0, revision r23). Read each changed file's relevant range once; hard budget 19 reads, zero glob/grep before the first edit.

# Deltas (exact)
1) internal/service/reload.go — guard + wording: at the reinstatement-set computation (immediately AFTER the set is computed, BEFORE the prompt-dependency gates around :525-534) add: if the build mode is refresh AND the reinstatement set is non-empty, return an error formatted exactly `service: refresh reinstatement invariant violated for server %q`. This is the ONLY guard form (no emission-suppression variant). Also ensure the emission loop stays post-commit and per reinstated server.
2) internal/service/durable_test.go — (a) reload-leg purge oracle: make the drop-reload's PersistPrompts FAIL so the else-branch restores previous prompts including the dropped server's rows; on the re-add assert the persisted PromptSnapshot contains NO rows for the reinstated server. (b) AC25(b) restart leg: after the survived post-rename failure, restart with the published snapshot as durable base and an EMPTY pending set, a capturing Logger, and assert ZERO new binding_reinstated records and the returned admission error. (c) fix the two false comments at :215-216 and :255-256 ("never rebinds" / "refuses to rebind") to describe reinstatement.
3) cmd/mcp-bridge/serve.go — shutdown ordering: cancel the run context BEFORE awaiting loopErr, wait for loop.Start to return (join writers), then Store.Close UNCONDITIONALLY on every path (early returns after storage.Open before the loop exists, and on drain expiry). Do not skip Close on expiry. This removes the 10 s listener-failure hang.
4) cmd/mcp-bridge/startup_failure_test.go — extend TestStartupListenerServeFailureClassified (or add the lifecycle regression) so it deterministically overlaps a refresh pass with teardown (short refresh interval + listener failure + drain window; there is no blocking SavePrompts hook; only serveListenerFn/testServeNow are swappable) and passes under -race.
5) internal/service/reload_test.go is NOT granted — put TestRefreshNeverEmitsReinstatement in internal/service/durable_test.go. It must build a refresh pass whose base snapshot carries a retired binding for a configured server, supply PersistPrompts, and assert the exact guard error and ZERO binding_reinstated records (RED before delta 1).
6) internal/storage/reconcile_test.go — add the falsifiable assertions in BOTH fingerprint sub-cases of TestReconcileReinstatesConfiguredTombstonedServer: GenerationSequence+1, previous snapshot DeepEqual-unmutated, next.Validate()==nil, BindingAllowed(id,sameFp); DISTINCT case only: !BindingAllowed(id,oldFp). Schema-1 test: add nil-binding failure and fingerprint assertion. Fix the :14-16 comment that tombstones "never rebind".
7) docs/logging-contract.md + cmd/mcp-bridge/logging_contract_test.go — the emitted operations are startup and reload; amend the "startup, reload, or refresh" wording at docs :77/:552 and the test strings at :704/:706; keep the :549 row byte-identical and first, keep the :76 and :568 assertions. CHANGELOG entry stays.

# Verify (all must exit 0; report each)
1) test "$(go test ./internal/storage -list 'TestReconcile|TestValidateRejects' | grep -cxE 'TestReconcile(ReinstatesConfiguredTombstonedServer|ReinstatementIsolatesSiblingServers|KeepsUnconfiguredTombstone|RebindsEndpointIdentityChange|ReinstatesSchema1RetiredBinding)|TestValidateRejectsBoundsAndIdentityConflicts')" = 6
2) go test ./internal/storage -run 'TestReconcileReinstatesConfiguredTombstonedServer|TestReconcileReinstatementIsolatesSiblingServers|TestReconcileKeepsUnconfiguredTombstone|TestReconcileRebindsEndpointIdentityChange|TestReconcileReinstatesSchema1RetiredBinding|TestValidateRejectsBoundsAndIdentityConflicts' -count=1
3) test "$(go test ./internal/service -list 'TestStartup|TestReloadReinstates|TestRefreshNeverEmits' | grep -cxE 'TestStartup(ReinstatesConfiguredRetiredServerUnbound|ReinstatementDropsStalePromptRowsAcrossRestarts|ReinstatementEmitsExactlyOneWarnAtCommit|ReinstatementPostRenamePersistFailure|PreservesPromptsWithoutReinstatement|TombstonesAServerTheConfigDropped)|TestReloadReinstatesDroppedThenReaddedServer|TestRefreshNeverEmitsReinstatement')" = 8
4) go test -race ./internal/service -run 'TestStartupReinstates|TestStartupReinstatement|TestStartupPreservesPrompts|TestReloadReinstates|TestStartupTombstonesAServerTheConfigDropped|TestRefreshNeverEmitsReinstatement' -count=1
5) go test -race ./cmd/mcp-bridge -run '^TestStartupListenerServeFailureClassified$' -count=1
6) test "$(go test ./internal/observe -list 'TestBindingReinstatedEntryRecordShape' | grep -cx 'TestBindingReinstatedEntryRecordShape')" = 1; test "$(go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge -list 'TestLoggingContractR8EventMessagesOperationsAndSchemaVersion|TestLoggingContractDocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants' | grep -cxE 'TestLoggingContract(R8EventMessagesOperationsAndSchemaVersion|DocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants)')" = 2
7) go test ./internal/observe ./cmd/mcp-bridge -run 'TestBindingReinstatedEntryRecordShape|TestLoggingContractR8EventMessagesOperationsAndSchemaVersion|TestLoggingContractDocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants' -count=1
8) go test -race -p 1 ./...
9) go test -coverpkg=./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=coverage.out ./... ; go run ./cmd/covcheck
10) go vet ./...
11) gofmt -l internal/storage/reconcile.go internal/storage/reconcile_test.go internal/service/reload.go internal/service/durable_test.go internal/observe/log.go internal/observe/log_test.go cmd/mcp-bridge/logging_contract_test.go cmd/mcp-bridge/serve.go cmd/mcp-bridge/startup_failure_test.go  (exit 0 AND empty stdout)

# Report
STATUS COMPLETE|BLOCKED, files changed, per-command exit codes, RED/GREEN evidence for the guard and race tests, coverage number, deviations. No files outside the 11 granted paths.
